d:
Bihar ke hajipur men dipavli ki rat ek pati par apni patni ki goli markar hatya karne ka aarop laga hai. rajput koloni men rakesh chauhan ne kathit taur par apni laisensi pistal se patni ke sir men goli mar di aur pharar ho gaya. is khauphnak vardat ki chashmadid beti kritika raj ne pulis ko bataya ki ghatna se pahle mata-pita ke bich vivad huaa tha.
Aakhir dipavli ki rat aisa kya huaa ki ek parivar ki khushiyan matam men badal gaeen? aaropi pati ki talash men pulis ki chhapemari jari hai.
